info.title: User Management (System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM))
info.description: The service provides business user details via SCIM protocol. You can use this interface to maintain and retrieve business users. In addition to this, you can assign business roles and business user groups to them.

x-sap-shortText: Read and manage business users from an external system using the System for Cross-Domain Domain Identity Management (SCIM) protocol

values.text: System for Cross-domain Identity Management Integration (SAP_COM_0465)

x-servers.description: REST API endpoint for the user management API of the Authorization and Trust Management service.
